name: openamx
description: OpenAMX is an open-source, text-based, computable document format for Asset Management knowledge.

scripts.render:hello: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/hello-world.amx --out examples/hello-world.html
scripts.render:transformer: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/transformer-strategy.amx --out examples/transformer-strategy.html
scripts.render:fleet: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/asset-fleet-risk-analysis.amx --out examples/asset-fleet-risk-analysis.html
scripts.render:typed: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/typed-asset-analysis.amx --input asset=examples/typed-asset.json --input screenings=examples/typed-screenings.csv --input reviewedAt=examples/typed-reviewed-at.json --out examples/typed-asset-analysis.html
